noun_definition: yourself refers to the user who is currently interacting with the system and is suggested in the mentions auto-suggestion list.
Here refers to a mention option in the auto-suggestion list that allows users to notify all members of a channel or group in a messaging or collaboration platform.
Option refers to a choice in the mentions auto-suggestion list that includes the user themselves and the @here mention.
mention refers to the feature that allows users to tag themselves or others in discussions, which is suggested to be included in the auto-suggestion list for mentions.
Auto-suggestion refers to the feature that provides a list of potential mentions, including options like "yourself" and "@here," when a user types in a mention field.
list refers to the collection of user mentions that are suggested automatically when typing in a mention field.
